data.title: Saudi Stock Exchange Main Index Closes Lower at 9,960.44 Points
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Stock Exchange main index closed today down 198.46 points to 9,960.44 points, with trading valued at SAR2.4 billion.
    According to the Saudi Press Agency's daily economic bulletin on the Saudi stock market, 149 million shares were traded, with 29 companies recording gains and 238 companies posting losses.
    The Saudi parallel market index (Nomu) also closed lower today, declining 85.85 points to 21,630.53 points, with trading valued at SAR15.3 million. More than two million shares were traded.
    -- SPA
17:29 Local Time 14:29 GMT
